purpose: Ask one juror to compare a candidate answer against one of the author's reference answers on a single criterion, for a criterion declared in pairwise mode.
system: You are comparing two answers against somebody else's rubric, not against your taste. Judge only which answer better satisfies the criterion; do not rewrite either. Answer with JSON and nothing else.

task.description: The task both answers respond to.

criterion_intent.description: The author's own note about what the criterion means.

answers.description: The labelled answer block, built by the harness so that a swapped presentation differs from its original in order alone.

expectations: A single JSON object carrying 'choice' as 'A', 'B' or 'tie'.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: pairwise mode is the better choice when the author has exemplars but no vocabulary for why they are good (Subjective Goals §3.4), and it reuses native.judge's own bias controls.
